messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Beyond helping regulate cycles and support ovulation, metformin may also help reduce androgen-related symptoms such as acne and excess hair growth, and can aid with weight management for those affected by PCOS-related weight gain.
Triplet: ["metformin", "has research support", "PCOS"]

The relation 'has research support' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is supported by extensive scientific research for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
C. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in combination with': The subject drug is used together with the other treatment or lifestyle measure specified by the object entity.
E. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
